# Sushi Tours & Travels — LLMs Context

> Premier chauffeur-driven car and Tempo Traveller rental service based in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India. Specializing in 9, 12, 17-seater Tempo Travellers, Force Urbania luxury vans, Toyota Innova Crysta, premium sedans, and luxury tourist buses with verified professional chauffeurs for outstation trips, local Bangalore rentals, airport transfers, corporate transport, and weddings.

## Core Services
- [Outstation Cab Service Bangalore](https://www.sushitravels.com/services/outstation-cab-bangalore): Chauffeur-driven outstation round trips and multi-day holiday packages starting at ₹13/km.
- [Tempo Traveller Rental Bangalore](https://www.sushitravels.com/services/tempo-traveller-rental-bangalore): 9-seater, 12-seater, and 17-seater luxury Tempo Travellers with pushback seats, individual AC vents, and luggage space.
- [Force Urbania Rental Bangalore](https://www.sushitravels.com/vehicles/force-urbania-luxury-van): Ultra-luxury European-styled van with panoramic windows, plush recliner seats, and whisper-quiet cabin acoustics.
- [Airport Taxi Service Bangalore](https://www.sushitravels.com/services/airport-taxi-bangalore): On-time guaranteed pickup and drop to Kempegowda International Airport Bengaluru (BLR Airport) with flight tracking.
- [Corporate Car Rental Bangalore](https://www.sushitravels.com/services/corporate-car-rental-bangalore): Executive transportation, employee shuttles, and VIP delegate cabs with corporate invoicing and GST receipts.
- [Wedding Car Rental Bangalore](https://www.sushitravels.com/services/wedding-car-rental-bangalore): Coordinated guest transportation, luxury bridal sedans, and tempo traveller convoys.

## Fleet Overview & Standard Rates
- **Sedans (Swift Dzire / Toyota Etios)**: 4 passengers + driver. Starts at ₹13/km. Ideal for city transfers and budget outstation.
- **Toyota Innova / Crysta**: 6-7 passengers + driver. Starts at ₹19/km. The gold standard for family highway comfort and ghat navigation.
- **Force Tempo Traveller (9 / 12 / 17 Seater)**: 9 to 17 passengers + driver. Starts at ₹22/km. 1x1 or 2x1 pushback bucket seats, high-roof, LED entertainment.
- **Force Urbania (10 / 13 / 17 Seater)**: 10 to 17 passengers + driver. Luxury category. Reclining captain seats, panoramic view, climate control.
- **Toyota Fortuner**: 6 passengers + driver. Premium 4x4 SUV for executive transfers and VIP delegates.
- **Tourist Coaches & Buses (22 to 50 Seater)**: Custom group packages for large corporate offsites and family events.

## Popular Outstation Routes from Bangalore
- [Bangalore to Coorg Cab](https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-coorg-cab): ~250 km (5.5 hrs). Mysore Expressway corridor.
- [Bangalore to Ooty Cab](https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-ooty-cab): ~270 km (6 hrs). Mysore - Bandipur national park route (night traffic restrictions apply).
- [Bangalore to Mysore Cab](https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-mysore-cab): ~145 km (2.5 hrs). NH-275 10-lane expressway route.
- [Bangalore to Tirupati Cab](https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-tirupati-cab): ~250 km (5 hrs). Pilgrimage round trip with driver temple assistance.
- [Bangalore to Wayanad Cab](https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-wayanad-cab): ~280 km (6.5 hrs). Kozhikode corridor via Gundlupet forest.
- [Bangalore to Chikmagalur Cab](https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-chikmagalur-cab): ~245 km (4.5 hrs). Coffee plantation getaway via Hassan NH-75.
- [Bangalore to Hampi Cab](https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-hampi-cab): ~340 km (6 hrs). UNESCO heritage circuit via Chitradurga / NH-48.
- [Bangalore to Goa Cab](https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-goa-cab): ~560 km (10-11 hrs). Coastal road trip via Hubli/Dharwad.
- [Bangalore to Pondicherry Cab](https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-pondicherry-cab): ~310 km (6.5 hrs). French colonial beach tour via Krishnagiri.

## Transparency, Pricing & Booking Terms
- **Kilometer Basis**: Outstation minimum billing is 250 km/day or 300 km/day depending on vehicle class.
- **Tolls & Parking**: Toll charges (FASTag) and parking fees are charged on actuals.
- **Interstate Permits**: Paid on actuals at state borders as per RTO rates.
- **Driver Allowance (Bata)**: Standard day allowance ₹400-₹600 depending on vehicle. Night allowance applicable between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM.
- **Safety Standard**: All vehicles equipped with GPS tracking, emergency first aid, commercial speed limiters (80 km/h as per MoRTH mandate), and verified drivers.
